# CNN Academy

> > CNN Academy is a professional journalism training institution offering multimedia storytelling education, master's degree programs, and digital journalism workshops across global locations including Dublin, Atlanta, Abu Dhabi, and Hong Kong.

CNN Academy provides comprehensive journalism education through hands-on courses in mobile storytelling, AI journalism, newsroom simulation, and digital media production. The program combines CNN's editorial expertise with academic partnerships like University College Dublin to develop next-generation journalists and storytellers.

## Key Topics

- Journalism Training
- Multimedia Journalism
- Digital Journalism
- Mobile Storytelling
- Masters Degree Programs
- Newsroom Simulation
- AI Journalism
- Storytelling Education
- LumaFusion Video Editing
- CNN Editorial Standards
- Journalist Development
- Dublin Ireland Campus
- Atlanta Georgia Campus
- University College Dublin Partnership

- [Workshops](https://academy.cnn.com/workshops/): CNN Academy workshops on digital journalism, TV production, and storytelling
- [Writing for Digital](https://academy.cnn.com/hub-course/writing-for-digital/): Digital journalism course on writing, headlines, and SEO by Cathy Straight

## Student Productions

- [Passing Down the Wing](https://academy.cnn.com/home/?student-productions=passing-down-the-wing): Student production story about falconry tradition passed through generations
